fact: The evaluation of Mali Numérique 2020 shows 27.30% overall execution (18 of 66 actions) and 54.5 of 224.792 billion mobilised; the new PNDEN and its Mali 2025-2029 plan were validated at a national workshop on 24 October 2024.
title: Économie numérique : Une nouvelle politique pour corriger les lacunes
